title: The station at the end
logline: Seattle's bus station in 2000, drawn from nothing, the sequence's last page in the book: the arrivals door, a rank of taxis, rain, and a bag with a strap set down on the curb with no one holding it. Where the route ends. He never saw it.

panels.composition: A city bus station's arrivals door in rain, a rank of taxis, wet pavement reflecting their lights, and on the curb a canvas bag with a strap set down with no one beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a city bus station's arrivals door in rain with a rank of taxis and wet pavement reflecting their lights, a canvas bag with a strap set down alone on the curb, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The route's end. The bag set down; no one.
